scope: Make UNDERLAY DXF clip and inverse-clip count/vector allocation failures leave parser occurrence state retryable.

behavior: Groups 11 and 12 calculate the next clip vertex index locally, use DRW::resize, store X, and commit the corresponding occurrence index only after success.
Group 170 reserves the bounded inverse-clip vector before committing the declared count and count-seen flag.
implementation.failureInjection: A focused test injects one std::bad_alloc at each of the clip-vector resize, inverse-clip count reserve, and inverse-clip vertex resize boundaries. Each failure is observed once, leaves the affected logical vector empty, and a corrected retry of the same group succeeds with the expected X/Y coordinates.

validation.fixturePolicy: The fault-injection controls parse locally generated in-memory DXF group records. No external DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: This covers the named UNDERLAY DXF parser allocation boundaries only. It does not qualify physical producer breadth, whole-document conversion, or native UNDERLAY semantics.
No DWG parser layout or behavior was changed, and no support claim is promoted.
next: Continue P6 safety review at another reproduced parser allocation or rollback boundary while retaining fast-only validation for bounded slices.
